title: Summarize README section
task_brief: Use read_file to access the project README.md, then use write_file to create a new SUMMARY.md file containing a condensed version of the main features section.

title: Create project documentation structure
task_brief: Use create_directory to establish a new 'docs' folder, then use write_file to create an index.md file inside it with a basic table of contents.

title: Inventory configuration files
task_brief: Use search_files to find all .json and .yaml configuration files in the workspace, then use write_file to create a CONFIG_INVENTORY.txt listing their paths.

title: Reorganize test files
task_brief: Use list_directory to identify test files in the root directory, then use move_file to relocate them into a 'tests' subdirectory (create with create_directory if needed).

title: Generate directory size report
task_brief: Use list_directory_with_sizes on the main project folders, then use write_file to create a STORAGE_REPORT.md showing which directories consume the most space.

title: Update copyright headers
task_brief: Use read_multiple_files to examine the headers of all .py files, then use edit_file to update copyright year to 2024 in files that need it.

title: Create visual project map
task_brief: Use directory_tree to get the complete workspace structure, then use write_file to save it as PROJECT_STRUCTURE.txt for documentation purposes.

title: Consolidate license information
task_brief: Use read_file to access LICENSE and any third-party license files, then use write_file to create LICENSES.md combining all license texts with clear attribution.

title: Verify file metadata
task_brief: Use get_file_info on critical project files (package.json, README.md, etc.) and use write_file to create a FILE_METADATA.json documenting their sizes and modification dates.

title: Extract code comments for review
task_brief: Use read_text_file to examine source files, identify TODO and FIXME comments, then use write_file to create a REVIEW_ITEMS.md file listing all items needing attention.

title: Standardize markdown formatting
task_brief: Use read_file to access all .md files, then use edit_file to ensure consistent heading styles (ATX-style with # symbols) throughout documentation.

title: Create backup structure
task_brief: Use create_directory to establish a 'backups' folder with dated subdirectories, then document the backup strategy in a BACKUP_POLICY.md file using write_file.

title: Audit accessible directories
task_brief: Use list_allowed_directories to identify all accessible paths, then use write_file to create an ACCESS_MAP.txt documenting the workspace boundaries.

title: Merge changelog entries
task_brief: Use read_multiple_files to access CHANGELOG.md and any RELEASE_NOTES files, then use write_file to create a unified COMPLETE_HISTORY.md in chronological order.

title: Organize media assets
task_brief: Use search_files to find all image files (.png, .jpg, .svg), then use move_file to organize them into an 'assets/images' directory structure.

title: Document API endpoints
task_brief: Use read_text_file to examine route definition files, extract endpoint information, then use write_file to create an API_REFERENCE.md documenting all available endpoints.

title: Create contributor guide
task_brief: Use read_file to review existing README.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, then use write_file to create a CONTRIBUTING.md with guidelines for new contributors.

title: Rename deprecated files
task_brief: Use list_directory to find files with 'old' or 'deprecated' in their names, then use move_file to rename them with a .deprecated extension for clarity.

title: Generate dependency list
task_brief: Use read_file to access package.json or requirements.txt, extract dependency names and versions, then use write_file to create a DEPENDENCIES.md with formatted tables.

title: Create example templates
task_brief: Use create_directory to make a 'templates' folder, then use write_file to create sample configuration files (config.example.json, .env.example) with placeholder values.

title: Index media files
task_brief: Use read_media_file to access image metadata, then use write_file to create a MEDIA_CATALOG.md listing all media assets with their dimensions and file sizes.

title: Update installation instructions
task_brief: Use read_file to review current README.md installation section, then use edit_file to add platform-specific instructions for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: Create quick reference guide
task_brief: Use read_multiple_files to review documentation files, extract key commands and shortcuts, then use write_file to create a QUICK_REFERENCE.md cheat sheet.

title: Organize configuration files
task_brief: Use search_files to locate all .config, .json, and .yaml files, then use move_file to consolidate them into a 'config' directory (create with create_directory).

title: Document environment variables
task_brief: Use read_text_file to examine .env.example or configuration files, identify all environment variables, then use write_file to create ENV_VARS.md documenting each variable's purpose.

title: Create troubleshooting guide
task_brief: Use read_file to review issue templates and common problems, then use write_file to create TROUBLESHOOTING.md with solutions to frequent issues.

title: Generate file statistics
task_brief: Use directory_tree and get_file_info to analyze the workspace, then use write_file to create STATS.md showing total files, directories, and storage usage by file type.

title: Standardize file naming
task_brief: Use list_directory to find files with inconsistent naming (spaces, mixed case), then use move_file to rename them following kebab-case or snake_case conventions.

title: Create glossary of terms
task_brief: Use read_multiple_files to review documentation and code comments, identify technical terms, then use write_file to create GLOSSARY.md with definitions.

title: Document build process
task_brief: Use read_file to examine build scripts and configuration, then use write_file to create BUILD.md documenting the complete build and deployment process.

title: Create archive structure
task_brief: Use create_directory to establish an 'archive' folder with year-based subdirectories, then use write_file to create an ARCHIVE_POLICY.md explaining retention rules.

title: Extract version information
task_brief: Use read_file to access package.json, setup.py, or version files, then use write_file to create VERSION_INFO.md documenting current version and release history.

title: Consolidate documentation links
task_brief: Use read_multiple_files to scan all .md files for external links, then use write_file to create RESOURCES.md with categorized links to external documentation.

title: Create testing checklist
task_brief: Use read_text_file to review test files and identify test categories, then use write_file to create TESTING_CHECKLIST.md for manual QA processes.

title: Update file headers
task_brief: Use read_file to check source files for missing headers, then use edit_file to add standardized file headers including filename, description, and author information.
